objective: Evaluate provider-generative QR composition against all eight supplied real-target classes under Core-owned local validation, bounded provider execution, and deterministic fallback.
scope: prompt/reference-hash binding at the engine boundary
bounded repair if evidence identifies a narrow repair opportunity

criteria.requirement: All eight supplied reference classes are represented by sanitized prompts and source SHA-256 bindings.
criteria.evidence: 8/8 source hashes independently matched cached inputs.

criteria.requirement: Every live provider artifact is saved immediately with model, seed, conditioning, prediction latency/cost estimate, and exact local scan evidence.
Provider scan claims never authorize export; Core locally decodes exact bytes and requires raw plus at least 6/8 checks.
criteria.evidence: 0/8 raw provider candidates authorized; forged optimistic replay rejected.

criteria.requirement: Provider failure or zero passing candidates produces a locally validated deterministic Level 1 fallback.
criteria.evidence: 4/4 fallback candidates passed 8/8 with exact payload equality.

criteria.requirement: Visual sponsor gate is separately classified; sponsor-ready requires clear identity-level recognizability on at least 6/8 target classes without labels.
criteria.evidence: Raw clear 4/8 but unscannable; selected repairs clear 2/8 and QR-dominant; sponsor-ready 0/8.

criteria.requirement: Core builds/tests, provider tests, contract parse, evidence hashes, and clean owned-scope diff pass.
criteria.evidence: Core 24/24, Artistic 136/136 TypeScript plus 6/6 Python, schemas and evidence validator passed; contracts unchanged.

allowed: bounded paid provider predictions using existing credit

recoveryAction: Preserve completed prediction bytes and resume at the first missing target; never rerun successful predictions merely to recreate logs.
nextTransition: Product Architect independently verifies evidence and decides whether a different dual-conditioned provider/model warrants a separate gate. Composite repair remains evidence-only and must not ship.
